dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: A type of systems indexed by two real constants. Its supplied constructor D006 packages nonzero density, two real-valued fields, and the first-order differential relations D007 at every real coordinate pair.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Quantifying over system includes the globally imposed first-order equations and the pressure and velocity fields carried by that system.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the second field of a system, its pressure function from Real × Real to Real, represented in curried form.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the function whose second time and second space derivatives occur in the conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the third field of a system, its velocity function from Real × Real to Real, represented in curried form.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects the function whose two orders of mixed partial differentiation are assumed equal at the chosen point.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a field f, returns deriv of the function ξ ↦ f(ξ,t) at x, differentiating the first coordinate while fixing the second.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the spatial partial derivative used to form the time derivative of the velocity's spatial derivative and the second spatial derivative of pressure.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a field f, returns deriv of the function τ ↦ f(x,τ) at t, differentiating the second coordinate while fixing the first.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the time partial derivative used to form the second time derivative of pressure and the spatial derivative of the velocity's time derivative.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a system with constants B and ρ from a proof that ρ ≠ 0, functions p,u : Real → Real → Real, and a proof that D007(p,u,B,ρ,x,t) holds for every x,t.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Exposes the system's embedded hypotheses: nonzero density, existence of all four first coordinate derivatives everywhere, and two first-order equations everywhere.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: At a fixed (x,t), there exist real numbers pt, px, ut, ux such that the time derivative of p is pt, its spatial derivative is px, the time derivative of u is ut, its spatial derivative is ux, and pt + B·ux = 0 and ut + ρ⁻¹·px = 0. All six conditions hold together for the same four witnesses.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Because the system supplies this predicate for every (x,t), its fields satisfy p_t + B u_x = 0 and u_t + ρ⁻¹ p_x = 0 globally. Derivative witnesses may depend on the system and the coordinate pair.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that scalar multiplication of real numbers acting on real numbers is jointly continuous.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies analytic infrastructure for derivative predicates in the system equations; adds no hypothesis on the fields.

dependency_coverage.name: ContinuousMul.to_continuousSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Jointly continuous multiplication gives jointly continuous self-scalar multiplication when scalar action is multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the real scalar-action continuity instance used by HasDerivAt.

dependency_coverage.name: DenselyNormedField.toNontriviallyNormedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains a densely normed field's normed field structure and obtains the required nontriviality of its norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the real field eligible as the scalar domain of the derivative predicates.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts division from a monoid equipped with compatible inversion and division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Selects real division in the ratio B/ρ.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equality of two objects of the same type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses equality of the mixed derivative values, the concluding real equality, and the two system equations.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the division operation from a heterogeneous division instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Here both inputs and the result are real, so it forms the ordinary ratio B/ρ.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the multiplication operation from a heterogeneous multiplication instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All relevant products are real products, including (sqrt(B/ρ))²·pxx, B·ux, and ρ⁻¹·px.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the exponentiation operation from a heterogeneous power instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Raises the real square root to the natural-number exponent 2.

dependency_coverage.name: HasDerivAt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Asserts that a function has the specified derivative at a point, using the neighborhood filter of that point and a fixed base point.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires actual ordinary real derivatives with the displayed values. These are unrestricted derivatives on Real, not one-sided or within-set derivatives.

dependency_coverage.name: IsTopologicalRing.toIsTopologicalSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the additional ring structure in a topological ring to obtain a topological semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Part of the derivation of continuity of real multiplication; imposes no additional condition on pressure or velocity.

dependency_coverage.name: IsTopologicalSemiring.toContinuousMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts joint continuity of multiplication from a topological semiring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the continuous real scalar action required for differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the strict comparison relation from an ordered type's LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Expresses 0 < B and 0 < ρ using real strict order.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines natural-number powers using a monoid's repeated multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the exponent 2 in the conclusion an ordinary square.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Contains the fixed exponent 2; there is no quantified natural-number index.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets associativity requirements from a commutative ring structure without a required identity, retaining its operations and weaker laws.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies a weaker real algebraic structure used in the continuity-instance chain.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocCommRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity from a ring structure requiring neither an identity nor associativity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Preserves the real operations while supplying the structure expected by topological-ring infrastructure.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNonAssocRing.toNonUnitalNonAssocSemiring
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains addition, multiplication, distributivity, and zero laws while forgetting additive inverse requirements.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the real semiring structure used to obtain continuous multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalNormedCommRing.toNonUnitalCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the norm and metric requirements of a normed commutative ring without a required identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides underlying real ring operations for the continuity-instance chain.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity while retaining the seminormed ring structure without a required identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Helps obtain the seminormed additive group of real numbers used in the derivative's module instance.

dependency_coverage.name: NonUnitalSeminormedRing.toSeminormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains the norm, additive commutative group, and compatible pseudometric of a seminormed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the additive analytic structure of the real codomain for differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: NontriviallyNormedField.toNormedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the normed field underlying a nontrivially normed field.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Preserves the usual real field and norm in the analytic instance chain.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toNonUnitalNormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets the requirement of a multiplicative identity while retaining a commutative ring's norm, metric, and remaining operations.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies a weaker real normed ring structure needed by the displayed instance construction.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedCommRing.toSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Views a normed commutative ring as a seminormed commutative ring with the same norm and induced pseudometric.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the real seminormed structures used for scalar-module and topology instances.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedField.toNormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the normed commutative ring underlying a normed field.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the real ring and metric structures supporting the derivative predicates.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedField.toNormedSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Views a normed field as a normed vector space over itself, with scalar multiplication given by multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes real-valued derivatives take values in the usual one-dimensional real vector space.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedSpace.toModule
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the scalar module structure from a normed vector space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies ordinary real scalar multiplication and addition in the derivative codomain.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal using the specified numeral instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets 0 as real zero in positivity assumptions and 2 as a natural number in the exponent.

dependency_coverage.name: PseudoMetricSpace.toUniformSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the uniform structure carried by a pseudometric space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Connects the real distance to the topology used in derivative limits.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All physical constants, coordinates, field values, and derivative values are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.denselyNormedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: Equips the real numbers with their normed field structure and density of norm values between positive bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the nontrivially normed scalar field needed for ordinary real differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative group structure of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides addition, zero, and additive inverses for real-valued derivatives.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real multiplicative monoid with inversion and division, with division equal to multiplication by the inverse.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Interprets B/ρ as B·ρ⁻¹; the hypotheses ensure its denominator is nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict order on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the two scalar assumptions strict positivity assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid of real numbers with identity 1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides natural powers used to square the coefficient's square root.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real multiplication.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines multiplication in the conclusion and the real self-scalar action.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real number zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the lower bound in positivity assumptions and the zero in system relations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real commutative ring equipped with its usual norm and compatible metric.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supports the norm, additive group, and topology instances in the real derivative predicates.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedField
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real field equipped with its usual norm and metric, multiplicative norm law, and totalized inverse satisfying inverse of zero equals zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Fixes the scalar field and analytic structures for differentiation and supplies ordinary real division.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.pseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: The real pseudometric structure with distance d(a,b) = |a-b|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Ensures derivative limits use the usual topology of the real line.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: Takes the nonnegative square root after replacing a real input by its nonnegative part; consequently it is zero for negative inputs.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The input B/ρ is positive, so the coefficient is the square of its ordinary positive square root and equals B/ρ.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toNonUnitalSeminormedCommRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Retains a seminormed commutative ring's norm, pseudometric, and operations while forgetting the requirement of a multiplicative identity.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Part of the construction of the real seminormed additive structure for differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedCommRing.toSeminormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forgets commutativity while retaining the seminormed ring structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies the real seminormed ring from which the required pseudometric is extracted.

dependency_coverage.name: SeminormedRing.toPseudoMetricSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts a seminormed ring's compatible pseudometric structure.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the metric-based topology used in the scalar-continuity instance chain.

dependency_coverage.name: UniformSpace.toTopologicalSpace
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the topology underlying a uniform space.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Provides the usual real neighborhoods used by HasDerivAt.

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets the literal 0 using a type's zero element.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the positivity bounds the real additive identity.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns homogeneous division into a heterogeneous division instance with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the quotient in the conclusion to real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns homogeneous multiplication into a heterogeneous multiplication instance with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the displayed products to real multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns a power operation into a heterogeneous power instance retaining the base type as result type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes real bases and natural exponents to the monoid natural-power operation.

dependency_coverage.name: instIsTopologicalRingReal
dependency_coverage.meaning: A proof that the usual real topology and ring operations form a topological ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Supplies continuity of real multiplication and hence the scalar action used in differentiation.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal as that same natural number.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Makes the exponent precisely the natural number 2.

dependency_coverage.name: deriv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Evaluates the totalized Fréchet derivative of a one-variable function on the scalar 1. At differentiable points this is its ordinary derivative; the standard totalized derivative is zero at nondifferentiable points.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Defines the first partial-derivative functions. The system's global HasDerivAt assumptions ensure these first derivatives exist everywhere, so their interpretation does not depend on nondifferentiable-point defaults.

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Inequality, defined as the negation of equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The system constructor requires ρ ≠ 0, also implied by the target's stronger assumption ρ > 0.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Requires all four derivative assertions and both differential equations in D007 simultaneously.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification over a witness satisfying a predicate.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Introduces four real derivative witnesses at each coordinate pair. Their nested order is pt, px, ut, ux, and all are shared by the subsequent conjunction.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts addition from a heterogeneous addition instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the real sums pt + B·ux and ut + ρ⁻¹·px in the system equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Inv.inv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the inverse operation from an inversion instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Forms the real reciprocal of density in the second system equation.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Ordinary real addition.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Determines the sums in the two first-order differential equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instInv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Real multiplicative inversion, totalized at zero.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Since density is nonzero, its inverse is the ordinary reciprocal 1/ρ.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Turns homogeneous addition into a heterogeneous addition instance with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Routes the additions in D007 to ordinary real addition.

dependency_coverage.name: ContinuousSMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The property that the scalar-action map (a,v) ↦ a • v is jointly continuous in its two inputs.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real scalars and values this is continuity of multiplication, an ambient analytic property rather than regularity of pressure or velocity.

dependency_coverage.name: instSMulOfMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines a type's action on itself by its multiplication operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Identifies real self-scalar multiplication with ordinary real multiplication in the continuity dependency.

binders: Universally quantify over real constants B = bulkModulus and ρ = density; these are implicit Lean arguments.
Universally quantify over a system in LocalDef001 B ρ, carrying pressure p and velocity u, both functions Real → Real → Real, together with the nonzero-density and global first-order-equation data.
Under B > 0 and ρ > 0, universally quantify over real coordinates x,t and real values ptt, pxx, uxt, utx.

Inside the system condition, for every real coordinate pair (a,b), there exist real derivative witnesses pt, px, ut, ux. These witnesses are chosen for that pair and system; they are not required to be constants independent of the coordinates.
hypotheses: For every (a,b) in Real² there exist pt, px, ut, ux such that τ ↦ p(a,τ) has derivative pt at b, ξ ↦ p(ξ,b) has derivative px at a, τ ↦ u(a,τ) has derivative ut at b, and ξ ↦ u(ξ,b) has derivative ux at a, with pt + B·ux = 0 and ut + ρ⁻¹·px = 0.
At the selected (x,t), the function τ ↦ p_t(x,τ) has derivative ptt at t.
At the selected (x,t), the function τ ↦ u_x(x,τ) has derivative uxt at t.
At the selected (x,t), the function ξ ↦ u_t(ξ,t) has derivative utx at x.
At the selected (x,t), the function ξ ↦ p_x(ξ,t) has derivative pxx at x.
uxt = utx: the time derivative of the spatial derivative of velocity equals the spatial derivative of its time derivative at this point.
conclusions: Equivalently, at the selected point, ∂t(∂t p)(x,t) = (B/ρ) · ∂x(∂x p)(x,t), since B/ρ > 0.
mathematical_definitions: For any field f, f_x(a,b) means deriv(ξ ↦ f(ξ,b))(a), and f_t(a,b) means deriv(τ ↦ f(a,τ))(b).
HasDerivAt(f,d,a) asserts the ordinary two-sided real derivative of f at a exists and equals d; equivalently, the difference quotient tends to d as its nonzero real increment tends to zero.
The system's first-order relations are p_t(a,b) + B·u_x(a,b) = 0 and u_t(a,b) + (1/ρ)·p_x(a,b) = 0 for every real a,b.
The coefficient uses the nonnegative real square root and a natural-number square. Positivity makes c = sqrt(B/ρ) positive and c² = B/ρ.
The first coordinate is the spatial coordinate and the second is time in the field notation. Both coordinates range over the entire real line.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For any positive real constants B and ρ and any system consisting of real-valued pressure and velocity fields p and u on Real², with all their first spatial and time partial derivatives existing everywhere and satisfying p_t + B u_x = 0 and u_t + (1/ρ) p_x = 0 everywhere, the following holds at every real point (x,t): if the second time and spatial derivatives of pressure exist there with values ptt and pxx, and the time derivative of u_x and the spatial derivative of u_t exist there with values uxt and utx that are equal, then ptt = (sqrt(B/ρ))² pxx, equivalently ptt = (B/ρ) pxx.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The constants B and ρ are spatially and temporally constant real parameters, and both must be strictly positive. Variable coefficients, zero coefficients, and negative coefficients are outside the stated implication.

The fields are defined on the entire real plane, and the embedded first-order equations and first partial-derivative existence assumptions hold at every real coordinate pair. No restricted spatial domain or nonnegative-time domain is encoded.
Second derivative existence and mixed derivative equality are assumptions at the selected point. The theorem does not establish them or assume that they hold globally.
Equality of the two mixed velocity derivatives is explicitly required; no general commutation theorem or continuous-second-derivative hypothesis is encoded.
The regularity assumptions do not require joint differentiability, continuity of first or second partial derivatives, or membership in a globally C² function class.
Although deriv is a totalized operation, the embedded global first derivative existence conditions ensure the first partial-derivative functions have their genuine derivative meanings.
At a point where any displayed second or mixed derivative hypothesis fails, or the mixed values differ, the conditional assertion supplies no conclusion.

The statement does not assert existence or uniqueness of a system for arbitrary prescribed data. Its assumptions are nevertheless satisfiable, for example by constant pressure and velocity fields when B and ρ are positive.
Only the pressure equation is concluded. No second-order velocity equation, boundary or initial conditions, propagation theorem, or physical interpretation of a wave speed is asserted.
